dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Something noteworthy... Well, the weather is noteworthily nice today. And the breeze sure is comfortable. The ocean looks beautiful from here, too.

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Quiet days like this... Guess they're not so bad either, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, hello. I'm not doing anything, really, just sitting here, thinking about things...

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: For example, the acolyte exams are coming up and I've hardly prepared... It's not easy to memorize every prayer that every Moonchanter has ever recorded.

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: However, even if I don't pass, I can keep on being a regular follower, and everything will stay as peaceful and quiet as it is now — it doesn't sound all that bad, really. In fact, it sounds pretty great.

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Oh, leaving already? In that case... May Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar keep you safe... And may you have a quiet day.

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Oh, leaving already? In that case... May the moonlight shine upon you... And may you have a quiet day.

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Well... Regular followers like me need to pass exams for hymns and bles{RUBY#[D]kuuvahki}sings before we can become an "acolyte."

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Then, if I could show myself as devout and reliable as Ehrnrooth or Vernadska, I might one day rise to the rank of "priestess"...

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: But that would require me to take on greater responsibilities, so I'm better off staying as I am now... I think.
